## Story DD Coverage
- dd-2: 400 illegal-transition → Jira comment containing 'local status changed to ' AND zero update_issue HTTP 400 retries
- dd-4: Unit tests written and passing

## Testing Mode
RED

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_applier_comment_fallback.py
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: make lint-ruff
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: make format-check
- [ ] 400 illegal-transition triggers add_comment with 'local status changed to ' substring
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_applier_comment_fallback.py::test_400_illegal_transition_falls_back_to_comment
- [ ] Zero update_issue retries on 400 (call_count == 1)
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_applier_comment_fallback.py::test_zero_400_retries
- [ ] Non-400 JiraAPIError still re-raises
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_applier_comment_fallback.py::test_non_400_jira_error_reraised
- [ ] 400 without 'transition'/'workflow' keyword re-raises (heuristic boundary test)
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_applier_comment_fallback.py::test_400_field_validation_failed_reraised
- [ ] Comment-fallback emits structured warning log with key + mapped status (observability — silent success regression guard)
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_applier_comment_fallback.py::test_comment_fallback_emits_warning_log
- [ ] add_comment failure re-raises (does NOT swallow comment-POST errors)
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_applier_comment_fallback.py::test_add_comment_failure_reraises
- [ ] Existing applier tests still pass
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/ -k applier

## Implementation Notes
AcliClient.add_comment(jira_key, body) ALREADY EXISTS in plugins/dso/scripts/acli-integration.py:721 — no client surface change needed.

In applier.update_one (line 407+), wrap the _call_with_retry call:
```python
try:
    return _call_with_retry(client.update_issue, mutation.get('key'), **fields)
except JiraAPIError as exc:
    msg = (exc.message if hasattr(exc, 'message') else str(exc)).lower()
    if 'status' in fields and exc.status_code == 400 and ('transition' in msg or 'workflow' in msg):
        target_status = fields['status']
        logger.warning(
            'status_push_illegal_transition',
            extra={'key': mutation.get('key'), 'mapped_status': target_status, 'error': str(exc)},
        )
        client.add_comment(mutation.get('key'), f'local status changed to {target_status}')
        return {'status': 'comment-fallback', 'key': mutation.get('key')}
    raise
```

_call_with_retry already non-retries 4xx [400,500), so the test asserts client.update_issue.call_count == 1 confirms zero retries structurally.

add_comment exceptions propagate (do NOT swallow comment-POST errors — operator must see failures to post the fallback).

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: applier.update_one comment-fallback on 400 illegal-transition + structured log
